args.sql: SELECT v.account, v.name, v.on_hold, MAX(t.trans_date) AS last_activity, COUNT(t.id) AS txn_count FROM erp_vendors v LEFT JOIN erp_vend_trans t ON t.account=v.account WHERE v.vendor_group='REVIEW' GROUP BY v.account ORDER BY v.account
SELECT account, txn_type, trans_date, amount FROM erp_vend_trans WHERE account LIKE 'DVEN-%' ORDER BY account, trans_date
